title: UNIKIE-BENCH: Benchmarking Large Multimodal Models for Key Information Extraction in Visual Documents

layout.note: Three tall rounded panels side by side on a faintly tinted canvas. The left one runs top to bottom: schema and document box, a funnel down to a robot icon, a funnel on to the output box. The middle and right panels each stack titled boxes with a navy heading band and a row of document thumbnails, under a bold italic title and a count line.

lesson: Open a benchmark overview with one panel that defines the task through an empty and a filled structured output around a model icon, then show each track as a nested taxonomy: titled boxes with rows of real thumbnails under short labels and a count line under the panel title.
